title: Add nightly e2e schedule to CI
objective: Configure CI with a nightly cron schedule for e2e benchmark tests, and update existing job filters to properly separate fast/slow/e2e tiers.

plan_assets.asset_description: CI tier configuration with cron schedule

scope: Add schedule: cron: '0 3 * * *' trigger to ci.yml
Add e2e-benchmarks job running pytest -m e2e
Update test job filter to exclude e2e
Update slow-tests job filter to exclude e2e
implementation_steps: Add schedule trigger with cron expression
Update test job: -m 'not slow and not gpu and not e2e'
Update slow-tests job: -m 'slow and not e2e'
deliverables: Updated ci.yml with 3 tiers: fast, slow, nightly e2e
acceptance_criteria: CI has schedule trigger with cron expression
Fast tests exclude both slow and e2e

cases: test_ci_yaml_is_valid: parse .github/workflows/ci.yml with yaml.safe_load and verify top-level jobs dict
test_ci_tier_filters_are_correct: schedule cron '0 3 * * *', e2e-benchmarks job with -m e2e, test job excludes slow+gpu+e2e, slow-tests job excludes e2e

risks: Cron schedule causes nightly GitHub Actions minutes usage -- ensure the e2e-benchmarks job is scoped to one runner and has a sane timeout
Changing filters on existing test and slow-tests jobs risks silently un-covering suites if the marker taxonomy drifts
completion_notes: Added the nightly scheduled e2e tier and updated the existing fast/slow marker filters without introducing the failure protocol yet.
